# Pixel Passport art library

The catalog in `manifest.json` lists the original artwork used by the app. The expression, outfit, and action character sheets have equal cells in a 3 × 2 grid. The turnaround sheet has four columns. CSS classes in `storybook.css` select each cell with `background-position`. The Europe postcard atlas has four quadrants for Austria, Finland, Greece, and Venice.

The SVG icons in `icons/` are generated by `scripts/build-icons.mjs`. Run that script after changing a drawing in the source. The SVG files remain sharp at small UI sizes. The landscape, destination, skiing, and character images were created specifically for Pixel Passport from the user's visual references.

The app uses these assets as reusable UI pieces. Original PNGs are kept in the repository's `source-art/` directory for future editing. The public app uses optimized WebP copies. The map continues to use geographic coordinates and OpenStreetMap tiles. Destinations without a custom city postcard use a generic illustrated Alpine scene; their eventual city artwork can be added without changing saved trip data.
